Title: International Night
Description:
We invite you to represent anything that you feel connected to, that gives you a sense of belonging, or that you feel excited to explore. This could be a country, region, state, province, city, cultural heritage, or another community.

Your booth can be as simple or creative as you'd like! Share a favorite food, photos, traditions, crafts, music, clothing, or anything else that tells your story.

Title: Spring Celebration
Description: Organizing the adult-only celebration including food, drinks, theme, activities and decor

Title: All School Movie Night
Description: Arriving early to set up projector and speakers, any decorations, putting together treat bags, picking the movie

Title: Cocoa & Cookies
Description: Join your kids before dismissal for winter break for cocoa and cookies. We need people to run the cocoa table, and people to provide treats, potluck-style.

Title: Back to School Social
Description: Set up tables for after-school clubs, coordinate ice cream, run the welcome table with name tags

Title: Book Fair
Description: Book fair supported by the local bookshop. Not announced yet.

Title: Coffee Carts
Description: Let's redesign what our coffee carts are! What if we have a yogurt parfait bar? Or a fancy toast station?

Title: Helios Cares
Description: The Helios Cares team leads efforts that support our community, both internally and externally: community service drives, campus beautification, staff birthdays and gifts.

Title: Room Parents
Description:
Interested in being a room parent? Express interest here. New parents welcome! Sign-ups are hidden for privacy.

There will be about three room parents for each gradeband. A room parent forwards messages to the classroom chats, coordinates a few events, and puts together the yearbook write-up.

Title: Tech Team
Description: Help out with various tech things, such as learning how to set up for outdoor movie nights or setting up the photo booth

Title: Pi Day

Title: Family Escape Room Night
